content: 1. Are you currently employed as a healthcare worker or caregiver? Please select one of the following options: Yes, No, or Prefer not to disclose. If you select No, please proceed with the survey. 2. What is your gender? Please select one of the following options: Male, Female, or Prefer not to disclose. 3. What is your current occupation? Please provide a detailed response. 4. In which country do you reside? Please specify. 5. What industry do you work in? On a scale of 0 to 10, where 0 means you are never on your feet at work and 10 means you are on your feet the entire time, please rate your level of physical activity at work. 6. Is driving your primary responsibility at work? Please select Yes or No. 7. Does your job require travel (excluding your commute to and from work)? Please select Yes or No. 8. If your job requires travel, what type of travel is involved? Please select all that apply: Air, Motor Vehicle, Public Transit, or Bicycle. 9. What percentage of your workday involves travel? Please provide an estimate. 10. How would you describe the proximity of most of your work-related travel? Please select one of the following options: Local, Out-of-city/town, Out-of-state, or International. Work and Sleep Hours 11. On average, how many hours do you work per week? Please provide an estimate. 12. On average, how many days do you work per week? Please provide an estimate. 13. Do you work during the daytime, nighttime, or both? Please select one of the following options: Daytime, Nighttime, or Both. 14. If you selected Both, how many days per week do you work at nighttime? Please provide an estimate. 15. If you selected Both, how many days per week do you work during the daytime? Please provide an estimate. 16. What is the longest duration you worked in a single day during the past week? Please provide the number of hours. 17. What is the longest duration you worked in a single day during the past month? Please provide the number of hours. 18. What is the longest duration you worked in a single day during the past year? Please provide the number of hours. 19. What is the longest shift you have ever worked? Please provide the number of hours. 20. On average, how many hours do you currently sleep per day? Please provide an estimate. 21. What is the longest duration you have gone without sleep for work-related reasons? Please provide the number of hours. Brief Medical History 22. Do you take any medications that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please select Yes or No. 23. Have you ever been diagnosed with any medical condition that can cause drowsiness, sleepiness, or syncope? Please select Yes or No. 24. Does your vision require correction (e.g., glasses or contact lenses)? Please select Yes or No. 25. Do you experience difficulty seeing at night? Please select Yes or No. Situational Sleepiness Assessment 26. How likely are you to doze off or fall asleep in the following situations? Please rate each on a scale of 0 (Never) to 3 (High chance): Sitting and reading. Watching television. Sitting inactive in a public place (e.g., theater or meeting). As a passenger in a car for an hour without a break. Lying down to rest in the afternoon when circumstances permit. Sitting and talking to someone. Sitting quietly after lunch without alcohol. In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic. Driving History 27. How do you commute to and from work? Please select one of the following options: Drive (Car or Motorcycle), Public Transportation, Bicycle, Walk, or Other (please specify). 28. How would you describe the region through which you commute? Please select one of the following options: Urban, Suburban, or Rural. 29. On average, how long is your commute to and from work (each way)? Please provide an estimate in minutes. 30. How many years have you held a driver’s license? Please select one of the following options: Less than 5 years, 5–10 years, 11–15 years, 16–20 years, or More than 20 years. 31. How many motor vehicle accidents have you been involved in? Please provide a number. 32. How many of those accidents occurred due to falling asleep at the wheel? Please provide a number. 33. How many of those accidents do you attribute to sleep deprivation? Please provide a number. Motor Vehicle Accident History 34. Have you ever felt drowsy or fatigued while driving after work? Please rate on a scale of 0 (Never) to 10 (Always). 35. Have you ever fallen asleep at the wheel after work? Please rate on a scale of 0 (Never) to 10 (Always). 36. Have you ever had a near accident while driving after work? Please rate on a scale of 0 (Never) to 10 (Always). 37. Have you ever had an accident while driving after work? Please select Yes or No. Questions for Those with Sleep Deprivation-Related Motor Vehicle Accidents 38. What time of day did your accident occur? Please select one of the following options: Daytime or Nighttime. 39. Did your accident occur on a city road or highway? Please select one of the following options: City Road or Highway. 40. How would you describe the area where the accident occurred? Please select one of the following options: Urban, Suburban, or Rural. 41. If you require vision correction, were you wearing your glasses or contact lenses at the time of the accident? Please select Yes, No, or I do not require vision correction. 42. How long was your shift immediately prior to the accident? Please provide the number of hours. 43. How long was your shift one day prior to the accident? Please provide the number of hours. 44. How long was your shift two days prior to the accident? Please provide the number of hours. 45. How long was your shift three days prior to the accident? Please provide the number of hours. 46. How many night shifts did you work during the week of the accident? Please provide a number. 47. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in a visit to the emergency room? Please select Yes or No. 48. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in hospitalization? Please select Yes or No. 49. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in admission to an intensive care unit? Please select Yes or No. 50. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in life-threatening injuries? Please select Yes or No. 51. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in injuries to others? Please select Yes or No. 52. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in a visit to the emergency room for another person? Please select Yes or No. 53. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in hospitalization for another person? Please select Yes or No. 54. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in admission to an intensive care unit for another person? Please select Yes or No. 55. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in life-threatening injuries for another person? Please select Yes or No. 56. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in any chronic, permanent, or irreversible personal injury? Please select Yes or No. 57. Did you receive any government disability compensation due to this accident? Please select Yes or No. If yes, please provide the estimated amount or select Do not know/Do not wish to disclose. 58. Did your sleep deprivation-related motor vehicle accident result in any chronic, permanent, or irreversible injury to others? Please select Yes or No. 59. Did any persons involved in the accident receive government disability compensation as a result of the accident? Please select Yes or No. If yes, please provide the estimated amount or select Do not know/Do not wish to disclose. 60. Did the accident cause any psychological disturbance to you or your family members? Please select Yes or No. If yes, please specify: Acute Stress Disorder, Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder, Anxiety, Depression, or Phobia. Employer Policies 61. Does your employer have preventative policies, programs, or benefits in place to protect staff from driving while sleep-deprived? Please select Yes, No, or Do not know. 62. Do you feel these preventative measures are sufficient? Please select Yes or No. Future Studies 63. Would you be willing to participate in a prospective study involving a brief questionnaire before and after your work shift? Please select Yes, No, or Maybe. 64. If you selected Yes or Maybe, how long do you think a reasonable daily survey on work-related fatigue and sleep deprivation should take to complete? Please provide an estimate in minutes. 65. What type of survey would appeal to you most? Please select one of the following options: Paper-based (sent by mail), Paper-based (sent by email and printed by you), Phone application, Survey link sent by email, or Survey link sent by text message. 66. Would you be interested in being contacted with more information if such a study is initiated? Please select Yes or No.
